settings.title: Settings
profile.password.title: Change password
profile.password.done: Password changed, the other sessions ended
profile.password.tooShort: The password is shorter than 12 characters
profile.2fa.title: Two-factor authentication
recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.hint: Each code works once and replaces the code from the app if the phone is lost.
recovery.low: only a few are left, generate new ones
recovery.regenerateHint: The old codes stop working. Enter your password to confirm.
recovery.shown: Save the codes now: they are not shown again.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: Sign in with one button on the sign-in page, no login and no password. The key is stored on the device, in a password manager or in the keychain.
passkeys.unsupported: Passkeys need HTTPS (or localhost) with a domain name and a browser with WebAuthn support. If the address of the panel changes, the keys must be added again.
passkeys.name: Name (for example, MacBook)
users.title: Users
users.hint: All users have one role: administrator. Everyone has full access to all servers, including the terminal and files.
users.confirmPassword: All sessions of the user end.
users.confirmDelete: Delete the user {login}? Their sessions end and their dashboard is removed.
users.confirmReset2fa: Reset the 2FA, recovery codes and passkeys of {login}? Their sessions end.
users.passwordSet: Password changed, the sessions of the user ended
snippets.title: Snippets
snippets.hint: Terminal commands shared by all users. In the terminal the Snippets list can paste and run a command at once or only paste it.
snippets.name: Name
term.snippetsEmpty: No snippets. Add them in Settings.
docker.update.title: Update the container {name}
docker.update.text: The image is pulled again and the container is recreated with the same settings. It stops for a moment; if the new one does not start, the old one is brought back.
docker.update.compose: The container was created by docker compose: the service of the project is updated with docker compose pull and up -d.
